findings.finding: No exact product upstream has been selected; a Fork or derived-source relationship must not be invented.
Public upstream lineage cannot by itself prove employer non-use, non-overlap or ownership.
Automation cannot invent a Human contributor identity or Signed-off-by trailer.
An empty registry, policy document or workflow is not upstream, clean-room, independent-review, legal or release evidence.
Private CodexDoc locations and employer material must not enter public Git or implementation prompts.

release before Human legal admission rejected
